bullets.text: Residents in Tiruvallur urge the State Highways department to repair damaged concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar road over bridge, and the office should monitor these safety improvements.

stories.title: Chennai Citizen Connect: Damaged pathway on Manavalanagar ROB puts public at risk
takeaways: Broken concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB in Tiruvallur district endanger local pedestrians.
Residents demand immediate intervention from the State Highways department to ensure public safety.
stories.snippet: CHENNAI: Missing and broken concrete slabs on the road over bridge (ROB) in Manavalanagar have raised safety concerns among Tiruvallur residents, prompting them to urge the State Highways department to clear creepers…
